title: AI GMP Documentation Reviewer
short: Pre-reviews batch records, SOPs and logbooks for missing entries, calculation errors and good documentation practice issues.
symptom: Batch record review delays every release
directions: Upload the executed batch record or SOP draft. QA receives a list of gaps and inconsistencies to check, page by page.
problem: QA reviewers read hundreds of pages per batch to find missing signatures, blank fields, out-of-range values, calculation errors and undocumented corrections.
why: Review backlogs delay batch release, and missed documentation errors become inspection findings.
solution: Extracts entries from executed records, checks them against the master record and limits, recalculates yields and reconciliations, and flags good documentation practice issues for the reviewer.
limitations: Handwriting and scan quality limit extraction
Requires computerised-system validation and data-integrity controls
review: QA performs the official review and release; the tool’s list is an aid, not a record of review.
